mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, created_at, updated_at FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM diary WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE diary SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
